scope: Exploratory leave-one-corpus-out replay on six previously inspected corpora.
monitor: Nine nearest neighbors with the original corpus-level calibration and voting.
method: Exact grouped Shapley values. Evaluate every subset, refit scaling, recalibrate cutoffs, and average marginal changes over all orders in which traits can be added.
ranking: Primary net benefit is timely warnings minus false alerts. Early alerts get no credit. Absolute effect measures movement in either direction in the same utility. Improved and worsened are probabilities over a random trait order. Exact ties are listed alphabetically.
